name: Air Hardening Modelling Clay, White, 1 kg (1.1 lb block in US listings)
bestUse: Best for a larger first project or several small dishes
descriptionOriginal: A block of white air-hardening modelling clay from DAS, described by retailers as a smooth, refined clay that hardens in the air without baking.
whyWeLikeIt: A long-standing, widely sold white clay that suits a few small dishes in one go. A well-known art-supply name makes it an easy alternative if the first choice is out of stock.
limitations: We could not read a maker page for this exact block, so drying time, care and weight (1 kg versus 1.1 lb) are not confirmed here. Treat finished pieces as decorative only and follow the instructions on the pack.
specsEvidence: No maker page read. Retailer pages seen in search summaries 2026-11-20 only: Rapid Online (https://www.rapidonline.com/das-387500-air-drying-modelling-clay-1kg-white-06-5436) lists DAS 387500, 1 kg white, self-hardening, no baking; Jerry's Artarama lists the 1.1 lb white as air-hardening and AP certified non-toxic. Retailers disagree on age guidance and material description (mineral-based versus paper-based), so none is stated publicly. Dick Blick returned a restricted-access page.
suitability: A beginner wanting a plain white air-hardening clay from a familiar art-supply brand, if the Mont Marte block is unavailable.
